definitions: To clean or dry (something) by rubbing it with a cloth, a piece of paper, or one's hand.
To remove (dirt, a mark, or liquid) from something with a cloth, a piece of paper, or one's hand.
To pass a hand, a cloth, or something similar over a surface, typically to remove dirt or liquid.
To erase or remove (data) from a computer or other electronic device.
examples: He wiped the sweat from his brow.
Wipe your feet before coming in.
The company decided to wipe all old data from the servers.
